title: Cat-a-Comb: our cats already chose this bed, so let's build it
subtitle: A cat bed that is also a tunnel: a rectangular wood frame around a removable U-shaped foam cradle. Our cats found the shape themselves in an improvised version; this brief proposes three designs and a prototype plan.
summary: Our cats love an improvised setup: a foam mat folded into a U inside the wooden base of a coffee table, and a gap walled in by books. Cat-a-Comb turns it into a product: a wood frame around a removable U-shaped memory-foam core, as an Open Cradle, a Closed Tunnel (both 24″ × 10″ × 10″) or a bookshelf variant. The ask is to build two prototypes and trial them with other cats before deciding on production.
key_findings: Two of our cats choose an improvised version: a U-folded foam mat inside a wooden frame, and a gap walled by books.
The concept is a wood frame plus a removable U-shaped memory-foam core and a washable liner, open at both ends (bed and tunnel).
Three variants: Open Cradle and Closed Tunnel (24″ × 10″ × 10″), and the Bibliophile's Burrow bookshelf (36″ × 10″ × 14″).
Not yet tested: other cats, cost, pricing, demand, safety and manufacturing.
The ask: prototype the two simplest variants and run a home trial with colleagues' cats.
data_sources: Photos of our cats at home
